notes: Every number carries src indices into the unit's sources list. Imperial values converted, with the original in the note. Values marked estimate are ranges (midpoint), readings of an unclear source, or design fills where the source is silent (said in the note). Penetration tables live with the weapons in scripts/generate_roster.py; 30-degree figures are converted to normal impact with the per-range ratio of the 8.8 cm KwK 43 table, which gives both (Wikipedia 8.8 cm KwK 43).
